title: Warm Spicy Jamaican Veal Skillet
description: A light and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring veal, with a mother-sauce-base and a flexitarian-friendly twist, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This recipe is made in an iron teppan for a crispy crust and a tender interior.
instructions: Season the veal cutlets with salt and pepper.
Coat the veal cutlets in flour, shaking off excess.
Heat the oil in the iron teppan over medium-high heat.
Add the veal cutlets to the teppan and cook for 3 minutes per side.
Remove the veal from the teppan and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the teppan and cook until translucent.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar, and thyme to the teppan and stir to combine.
Return the veal cutlets to the teppan and simmer in the sauce for 5 minutes.
